This template is designed for the specific use of content that Electronic Arts releases exclusively through its YouTube channel.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{EASWYouTube|video=|text=|int=|date=|quote=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|int}} Can provide a link to the [[Wookieepedia]] article, if one exists.
*{{Para|date}} Date the Youtube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a channel's playlist, use <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{EASWYouTube|f2VmOqjV_7Q|Star Wars: Squadrons &ndash; "Hunted" CG Short|archivedate=20200914151033}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EASWYouTube|f2VmOqjV_7Q|Star Wars: Squadrons &ndash; "Hunted" CG Short|archivedate=20200914151033}}

<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{EASWYouTube|f2VmOqjV_7Q|Star Wars: Squadrons &ndash; "Hunted" CG Short|int=Hunted|archivedate=20200914151033}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EASWYouTube|f2VmOqjV_7Q|Star Wars: Squadrons &ndash; "Hunted" CG Short|int=Hunted|archivedate=20200914151033}}
